exposure: birthing in the Detroit Metro area
outcome: Unplanned cesarean for nonreassuring fetal heart tracing
cohort: A statewide cohort of 69,622 nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex (NTSV) birthing people in the US.
finding: Non-Hispanic Black birthing people had significantly higher odds of unplanned cesarean for nonreassuring fetal heart tracing compared to non-Hispanic White birthing people, even after controlling for individual and hospital-level factors.
mod_finding: Unplanned cesarean for nonreassuring fetal heart tracing was significantly more common among non-Hispanic Black birthing people compared to non-Hispanic White birthing people.
